sample_mean_interval.method: 95% normal interval on the sampled-block mean
sample_mean_interval.limitation: Describes dispersion in sampled blocks only; it does not correct temporal or endpoint/network sampling bias.

rev.method: mean REV per sampled block x estimated blocks produced in the sampled slot window; elapsed time comes from sampled block timestamps
rev.limitation: Systematic block sampling can retain temporal and endpoint/network sampling bias; the interval describes sample dispersion, not total error.

addresses.note: Unique non-vote fee payers seen in the sampled blocks only, not a daily total. A true daily active address count is the union over every block in 24 hours; unique counts do not scale from a sample the way sums do, because samples overlap. Extrapolating this number would overstate it, so the daily figure is reported as unavailable instead.

fee_split.note: Measured from each block's own fee reward entry; no burn rate assumed.
